note: One file, two consumers: the Gallery renders its parity strip from it, and tests/FluentJalium.Tests/Gallery/AstraGalleryCatalogTests.cs fails when it stops matching the styles Astra actually ships. Scope is the implicit-style universe - every TargetType a product dictionary restyles without an x:Key - because that is the set an app inherits silently.

parityLegend.audited: Upstream dictionary transcribed key for key with its blob recorded, states mapped, and at least one pixel assertion. Whatever is missing is named in gaps.
parityLegend.ported: Style came from the pre-Astra adapter and consumes Astra tokens, but the upstream key list was never transcribed verbatim and no pixel assertion covers it.
parityLegend.own-type: Jalium has no native type for this control, so an Astra-owned type carries the behavior; adaptation/05 records the demonstrated gap.
